user.title: MyCentsys Remote
user.description: Enter the mobile number registered on your MyCentsys Remote account. A one-time pin will be sent to it.

data_description.service_token: Only needed if service_token.json was not installed alongside the integration.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the MyCentsys servers.
error.invalid_phone: That does not look like a mobile number in international format.
error.invalid_otp: That pin was not accepted. Check it, or start again to request a new one.
error.invalid_service_token: The app service token was rejected.
error.missing_service_token: A service token is required to request a pin.
error.otp_refused: The server would not send a pin to that number. Check the number and region.

abort.already_configured: That mobile number is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different mobile number. Enter the number this entry was set up with.

data_description.extra_activations: Open, close and stop are always available on the cover entity. Pick any additional activations you want as buttons. Ones your operator does not support will simply be refused when pressed.

activate.name: Activate
activate.description: Sends a raw activation id to a MyCentsys operator.

trigger_id.name: Trigger id
trigger_id.description: The activation id, for example 34 for open/close or 35 for pedestrian.
